recordComplete: at RC1 (a1e7e170896fb4d15d80c5f30e7947888e6c39e8); the full tier (run 42538580332) passed on attempt 1; the GPU PC at-limit run was waived by the owner on 2026-11-10; the tag and the release were made after this record merged (see publishedRelease); the record as first merged in #589 was written before the tag was made

decisions: 2026-11-07, on the limits: "Forget about that "limit" - it was completely arbitrary. 1. Fix it 2. Agreed 3. Agreed 4. OK". These answered R113 (fix the format caps), R114 (measure on the GPU PC), R115 (raise the limits) and R116 (binary storage only if justified; not built). The owner also said that the old 3.75 and 8 GiB memory ceilings protected only the development laptop.

2026-11-08: "1. Yes 2. Release 1.9.0 when ready". "Yes" accepted D-108's fix (a glTF mesh used by one node imports as a group, R119). "Release 1.9.0 when ready" gives the same permission as 1.8.0: one live corpus run on the ChatGPT plan at the RC, then the tag v1.9.0 and the public GitHub release, without asking again unless a release-blocking problem turns up.

2026-11-10: "Let's just skip the GPU test for this. It's not a blocker for release." This waives the M10 row "At-limit acceptance (GPU PC, through the RC build)" for 1.9.0. The GPU PC was unreachable from 2026-11-08; on 2026-11-10 it was moved to a replacement machine with the same RX 6800 XT, with 16 GiB of which about 9 GiB was in use by a desktop session, so the at-limit cases could not run safely there, and the Blender import could not run because Blender is not installed there.

The release notes on main carry the correction; the support matrix and PR_ROADMAP R118 and R119 need it too. The 1.9.0 release notes say the refusal texts were printed 'when the package checks were replayed on 2026-11-08'; the logs record them on 2026-11-10. The texts agree; the date does not.
harness/smoke-190-glb.sh line 53 prints bodies=17 as a literal; the validate report of the same file gives bodies 36.

The R086.n review's Site note (scene.transform; three checks in each run) and Advanced note (one transaction.apply) disagree with the receipts (assembly.site_place with 3, 3 and 1 checks; two applies with 6, 6 and 7 checks). The record uses the receipts.
R089.a's D-091 row: the Evidence column says Open (2026-11-01); the Fix owner column and the count line after R114 say closed for the AMD GPU. Counted as closed for AMD and open for other hardware.

The walkthrough's push/pull stage B expected 3,998 faces at first and the product gave 2,000 for a plain push; the harness now uses newFace true and expects 3,999. The newFace semantics are not documented in the schema.

The 1.8.0 record reports one skipped test in the package check; the 1.9.0 check's log lists 17 'did not run' tests, all Skipped (opt-in *_real and sandbox tests). The 1.8.0 RC log lists the same 17 Skipped tests, so nothing changed; the 1.8.0 record understates its own log.
